decisions: The amplified FSBS clean rendering failed immutable-master clipping gates; this candidate uses the separately pinned direct pickup capture and requires timbre review in Keyboardia runtime.
Six direct-capture masters with canonical FLAT_TOP_CLIPPING errors are excluded; each affected deterministic round-robin group is reindexed to a complete 0..N-1 sequence.
Mapping identity comes only from the pinned SFZ opcodes; filenames were not used to infer pitch or velocity.
Every selected lossless source is SHA-256 pinned and maps to exactly one delivery output.
SFZ key-range warnings are retained as evidence; runtime nearest-root selection uses the declared pitch_keycenter roots.
Shipping gain preserves source relationships plus any inherited SFZ volume/group_volume adjustment.
One uniform -3 dB render gain targets a -3 dBFS pre-encode ceiling from exact anchor source-0044; no velocity layer is normalized independently.
The first uniform -3 dB encode candidate was rejected because AAC overshoot exceeded the -1 dBFS delivery ceiling; the replacement uses a uniform -5 dB group gain.
Production-footprint curation retains up to two complete variants per root/layer and caps 55 long direct captures at 6.0 s with a 100 ms tail fade; pitch/velocity identity is unchanged.
Candidate is not authorized for production until exact-hash blind listening and all objective review findings are dispositioned.
